description: cancelTransfer: Stage cancellation of a pending domain transfer. DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible once executed. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name whose pending transfer to cancel, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: cancelTransfer
